notes: Source = H.R. 1346 Engrossed in House (EH), the latest version, matching stage 'Passed House' (218-203 on 2026-05-13); no stage/vote drift. Every figure/date/threshold in the analysis (75,000 bbl/day, 75%, 150M gallons, Jan 1 2022, July 1 2028, Oct 1 2028, Dec 1 2022, 18 months, 90 days, 30 days, 2016-2018, 2025, 2027, 2028) verifies verbatim against source. No direction inversions, no fabricated entities (EMTS is real), no wrong-figure/wrong-account errors. All flags are minor: (1) recurring 'other refiners' narrowing of the source's 'other persons' (the sections[].detail row uses 'other persons' correctly); (2) 18-month rulemaking (subsection (f)) grouped under the 'Section 1(a)' label; (3) 150M-gallon cap stated flat vs source's energy-content-equivalent phrasing; (4) 'compliance year' vs source 'calendar year' 2027; (5) dropped 'to the maximum extent practicable' hedge; (6) dropped upper-bound enactment window on the Governor-notification transition; plus 3 minor technical omissions (savings clause, qualifying-small-refinery definition, attestation/ownership petition requirements) and unsourced/structural likelihoodReason framing (cosponsor count, support/opposition predictions, 60-vote procedure). Zero material issues.
